title: Zapier 'Updated record' polling trigger never fires for edits to existing records
symptoms: New records trigger the Zap, edits to them never do
Test step shows the updated record but live runs skip it
Zap history has no runs after a record changes
cause: Polling triggers dedupe on the primary key, which is id by default. An edited record keeps its id, so Zapier treats it as already seen.
fix: Make the primary key combine the id with the update timestamp, using primary in outputFields on platform-core 15.6.0 or later.
apply:
outputFields: [
  { key: 'id', primary: true },
  { key: 'updated_at', primary: true },
]
affected: Zapier Platform CLI polling triggers, primary keys from zapier-platform-core 15.6.0, as of 2026-10
